title: Green Wood
description: A mod that adds cacti as a wood type, including all the expected blocks form a wood type and a new barrel that slightly different.
body:
![A pile of green wooden blocks in a room with spruce and  stripped oak checkaboard walls and smooth stone floors, the pile of blocks consist ofa few blocks with green yellow woodd slabs and stairs with the same collour, a door with a space for a name plate, large copper porthole and copper hinges and a similar trapdoor with the same large copper port hole, and a stripped cactus and similar block the cactus barrel witch looks similar with two thick iron bands circleing it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d47b4c81010fe01b40771577188dd8cc6f34852.png)Green wood adds a new green woood type, cactus wood! cactus wood is aquired by striping a cactus with an axe, it can then be crafted into all the things you can usualy craft with wood*, and a new storage block, the cactus barrel crafted slightly cheaper but holds slightly less.




*(please note compatabilty issues are expected at this stage im having issues trying to tag the blocks as wood)
